map.以「里程表 15 万 km、车龄 5 年、年基准 2 万 km、超额费率 1 元: Example: odometer 150k km, age 5 years, annual base 20k km, excess rate 1 CNY/km, original value 100k CNY, tolerance 30%
map.预期里程=2×5=10 万 km；实际 15 万超 5 万 km；里程偏差率=(: Expected mileage = 2×5 = 100k km; actual 150k exceeds by 50k km; mileage deviation rate = (15-10)/10 = +50% (exceeds the 30% tolerance band, judged "over mileage"). Excess-mileage charge = 50k×1 = 50000 CNY; value adjustment ratio = -min(25%, 50%×0.30 = -15%) = -15%, i.e. original 100k minus 15k → adjusted valuation 85k. In leasing, an extra 50k excess charge is also due.
map.价值调整的上限是多少？: What is the ceiling of value adjustment?
map.超里程时每超 10% 扣约 3% 价值（偏差率×0.30），封顶 -25%；少里: On excess mileage, every 10% over deducts about 3% value (deviation rate × 0.30), capped at -25%; on under mileage, every 10% under adds about 0.5% value (absolute deviation rate × 0.05), capped at +5%. This both penalises severe excess mileage and rewards low-mileage sources.
map.容忍区间（tol）有什么用？: What is the tolerance band (tol) for?
map.tol 是允许的正常偏差比例（如 30%），偏差在此区间内判「正常磨损」不调整价: tol is the allowed normal deviation ratio (e.g. 30%); deviation within this band is judged "normal wear" and does not adjust value; only beyond it is charged or adjusted. Once the lease contract sets the tolerance, this parameter directly maps to the contract threshold.
